title: Chicken and Almond Indian-Italian Fusion
description: A unique blend of Indian spices and Italian flavors comes together in this dish featuring chicken and crunchy almonds.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with curry powder and cook in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
While the chicken is cooking, heat some oil in a pan over medium heat and sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the sliced almonds to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until fragrant.
Once the chicken is cooked, let it rest for a few minutes before slicing it into thin strips.
To serve, place a portion of fluffy basmati rice on a plate, top with sliced chicken, and drizzle with zesty mayonnaise.
Garnish with additional sliced almonds and serve hot.
